WorkflowSession remains the sole publisher of shared selector/device/run facts, each page remains the sole publisher of its ModeChoices and page projections, live accepted mode changes cannot republish ItemsSource/IcChoices or wake the hidden page, and full Catalog refresh retains authoritative choice publication. The bounded refactor changes no XAML, navigation, Application, firmware, composition, range, CRC, naming, or execution semantics and introduces no publication framework or second state owner.
